PRODUCT OVERVIEW

A collection of writing instruments including pens and pencils with original cases and boxes.

PEN DESCRIPTIONS

Cross Selectip Pen: Gold-tone finish with original black box featuring green velvet interior.

Cattleya Pen: Silver and gold-tone finish in original case.

Penmakers Pen: Wooden construction associated with Elliot Landes/Real Mother Goose, includes original box.

Rosewood Set: Rosewood pen and pencil set in fitted wooden case with gold-tone trim.

Egyptian Sarcophagus Novelty Pen: Gold, blue, and red finish with hieroglyphic designs.

Dragon-Motif Pen: Blue and gold with cloisonne-style finish.

Gold Filigree Pen: Ornate gold filigree design with black barrel.

Seabourn Cruise Line Pen: Silver-tone branded writing instrument.

MATERIALS AND CONSTRUCTION

Construction Materials: Metal, wood, enamel, and cloisonne finishes

Finishes: Gold-tone and silver-tone hardware

CONDITION NOTES

Items display wear consistent with collectible and used pieces. Cases show various scuffing and surface marks. Some pens show minimal use while others display more extensive handling marks. Includes original packaging and cases as noted for individual pieces.

282155522.description:
Natural Agate Geode Bookends
Polished Quartz Crystal Display Wedges, Pair
Natural Stone, Approximately 6.5 Inches Tall
This matched pair of substantial natural agate geode wedges functions as heavy decorative bookends or geological display specimens. Formed within volcanic cavities over millions of years, each half features polished face planes showcasing concentric agate banding around sparkling crystalline quartz druzy pockets, juxtaposed with natural rough matrix exteriors.
Polished front faces revealing natural banded chalcedony agate rings and central quartz crystal cavities
Natural unpolished rough mineral rind on outer curved surfaces
Cork protective pads affixed to the bottom to safeguard tabletop and bookshelf surfaces
Pair measures approximately 8 inches long, 4.5 inches wide, and 6.5 inches tall with a combined weight of 10 pounds
Condition:
Natural geological specimen with cut and polished display faces. Crystals and banding intact with no post-extraction fractures or structural damage. Natural surface pits and irregular fissures are inherent to geode formation. Cork base pads show light surface wear.
Thank you for all of your support!
